name: steer@12
after: steer@11 (PR 1820): its measure, prompts, drift limit, tier, methods, budgets and rule for profiles; a box of 0.7 of steer@11's on every knob, a new model and design, 16 profiles drawn by steer@7's rule and seed from this round's design
profiles: drawn after training: the midpoint of two design points that meet tier 2, steer@7's seed 71, 16 profiles
score: minus the largest absolute log10 change error over the four concepts, against the zero design on the same prompts

methods.gmoo: each profile as globalMOO queries on this round's trained model: every concept within tol of its target (an absolute band), uniq and coh at least the tier, drift at most drift_max; tol starts at start_tol and is multiplied by tighten whenever a query meets it; a query that ends without meeting it is asked again at the same tol, until the profile has used budget evaluations or a query returns no new evaluation
methods.additive: steer@3's additive model from steer@5's band lines; each cell solved on the model by differential evolution on minus the score plus a steep penalty outside the cell, the answer evaluated, the model shifted by the residual and solved again, budget evaluations per cell
methods.de: differential evolution on the same loss at tier 2, de_maxiter generations of 24, per profile
methods.lookup: the best point of steer@5's design of experiments

claims.precision_heldout: on the 64 held-out prompts, globalMOO's best design is within log10(1.5) of the target on every concept in at least 8 of the 16 profiles
claims.query: on the training prompts, globalMOO's worst miss is smaller than the design lookup's in at least 8 of the 16 profiles
claims.model: over the 16 profiles on the held-out prompts, globalMOO's worst miss is smaller than the additive model's in more profiles than it is larger; de and lookup are reported whichever way they fall
claims.reported: the number of design points that meet tier 2, profiles within log10(1.5) on training and held-out for every method, and the mean worst miss

measure: each concept: the mean over prompts of log10 of the prompt's soft rate plus the floor (steer@10's geo)
drift_note: 0.41 x 0.20: geo drift over arith drift, median over steer@8's held-out designs on the training prompts (steer@10's reads)
